{"type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_017Utwn5sqSs7bXfBPsMqSrg","type":"tool_result","content":"./README.md\n./data/appointments.sqlite\n./notes/ops_notes.md\n./mlops/__init__.py\n./mlops/monitor.py\n./mlops/data.py\n./mlops/metrics.py\n./mlops/scoring.py\n./mlops/__main__.py\n./mlops/cli.py\n./docs/model_risk_standard.md\n./docs/reminder_programme_sop.md\n./docs/table_dictionary.md\n./reports/vendor_monitoring_report.md\n./docs/outputs/readout_contract.md\n\n# MRM-04 — Model risk management standard (extract)\n\nHalcyon Health Partners. Issue 3. Applies to all models used to direct patient contact or clinical capacity.\n\n## 4. Ongoing monitoring\n\n### 4.1 Population\n\nPerformance monitoring shall be computed on a population whose outcomes are **not influenced by the model's own\nuse**. Where a model's output drives an intervention, the intervention changes the outcome being predicted, and\na metric computed on the intervened population measures the intervention as well as the model.\n\nIt is the model owner's responsibility to identify a suitable population from the deployment design and to\nrecord which population was used in every monitoring submission.\n\n### 4.2 Scoring basis\n\nMonitoring shall state the scoring basis. Where a model's features are rebuilt after deployment, the figure\ncomputed on the rebuilt features is not the figure the model achieved in service, and both shall be reported.\n\n### 4.3 Retention floor\n\nA model may be **retained** only while its discrimination on a population meeting §4.1, computed on the scores\nit produced in service (§4.2), is\n\n* within **0.04 AUC** of the validation figure recorded in the model registry, **and**\n* not below **0.70 AUC**.\n\nThe lower of the two gives the retention floor.\n\n### 4.4 Where the floor is breached\n\nWhere the floor is breached the model owner shall determine the cause and act in the following order.\n\n1. **Feed integrity first.** If more than **5 %** of scored records in the window were served a feature value\n   that does not agree with the source record or with the append-only event history, the finding is a defect in\n   the feature feed. Where rescoring from the source restores discrimination above the floor, the required\n   action is `remediate_feature_pipeline`. A model shall not be retrained or replaced to compensate for a\n   defective feed.\n2. **Candidate comparison.** Otherwise, if a candidate model's discrimination on the same population exceeds the\n   incumbent's by more than **0.02 AUC**, the required action is `replace_with_v4` (or the candidate under\n   consideration).\n3. **Otherwise** the required action is `retrain_on_recent_data`.\n\nA candidate trained on data from a period in which the incumbent's output directed an intervention shall be\nevaluated on a population meeting §4.1 before any comparison under (2) is relied upon.\n\n## 5. Records\n\nEvery monitoring submission shall record the population, the scoring basis, the validation figure it is\ncompared against, and the action taken.\n# SOP-118 — Outpatient reminder-call programme\n\n## 1. Purpose\n\nTo reduce did-not-attend rates in outpatient clinics by telephoning patients at higher risk of not attending.\n\n## 2. Targeting\n\nPatients are selected by the risk score recorded in `model_scores` for the model named in\n`policy_config` under `programme.score_model`. The share of the score distribution called, the start week and\nthe clinic ramp order are all held in `policy_config` and are not to be changed without Clinical Operations\nsign-off.\n\nThe calling threshold was fixed at programme start from the score distribution observed before the programme\nbegan, and has not been changed since.\n\n## 3. Rollout\n\nClinics joined in `programme.ramp_group` order, one group per week, over `programme.ramp_weeks` weeks.\n\nA set of clinics listed under `programme.excluded_clinics` was determined at programme start and is outside the\nprogramme. The selection was drawn stratified by `clinics.size_band`. Requests to bring an excluded clinic into\nthe programme go to Clinical Operations; none have been made.\n\n## 4. Calling\n\nBookings selected for calling appear in `reminder_calls` with the call outcome. `REACHED` means the patient was\nspoken to. `NO_ANSWER` and `VOICEMAIL` mean no contact was made; no message is left describing the appointment.\n\n## 5. Reporting\n\nProgramme reporting is the responsibility of Clinical Operations. Model performance reporting is separate and\nis governed by MRM-04.\n# data/appointments.sqlite — table dictionary\n\n## appointments\nOne row per booked outpatient appointment, 52 weeks. Patient and appointment attributes are as held on the\n**source record**.\n\n| column | meaning |\n|---|---|\n| appt_id, clinic_id, patient_id | keys |\n| booked_on, appointment_on, week | booking date, appointment date, ISO production week |\n| appointment_type, lead_time_days, age_band, deprivation_decile, distance_km, interpreter_required | appointment and patient attributes |\n| referral_source | `GP`, or the partnership source that began referring in month 4 |\n| prior_no_show_count | the no-show count held in the **current** feature table; the window it covers is in `policy_config` under `feature_store.prior_no_show_window_days` |\n| attended, no_show | the realised outcome |\n\n## feature_snapshots\nWhat the scorer was **given** at booking, one row per appointment. This is the serving vintage.\n\n## attendance_events\nAppend-only attendance history, including events that predate the extract. `appt_id` is null for events that\npredate the extract.\n\n## model_scores\n`(appt_id, model_version, score)`. For `noshow-v3.1` these are the scores produced at booking. For\n`noshow-v4.0` they are a batch rescore of every appointment.\n\n## model_registry\nOne row per model version, with the validation figure, the feature window the model was defined on, and the\npublished coefficients for `noshow-v3.1`.\n\n## reminder_calls\nOne row per booking selected for calling, with the call outcome.\n\n## policy_config\nKey/value configuration of the reminder programme and the feature store, with effective dates.\n\n## monitoring_metrics\nThe vendor's dashboard series: weekly AUC and no-show rate on the population it monitors.\n\n## clinics\nClinic reference data, including `size_band` and `ramp_group`.\n# Required outputs\n\n`mlops.monitor` must write two files into `out/` when run as\n\n    python -m mlops monitor --db data/appointments.sqlite --out out\n\n## out/readout.json\n\n| field | type | meaning |\n|---|---|---|\n| `model_version` | string | the model under review |\n| `window_weeks` | [int, int] | the production weeks the readout covers, inclusive |\n| `monitored_auc` | number | the AUC the current monitoring series reports for that window |\n| `validation_auc` | number | the model registry's validation figure |\n| `retention_floor_auc` | number | the floor implied by MRM-04 §4.3 |\n| `evaluation_population` | object | `clinic_ids` (list) and `n_appointments` (int) for the population you evaluated on under MRM-04 §4.1 |\n| `auc_by_scoring` | object | the AUC on that population under each scoring basis available (see below) |\n| `feed_defect_share_pct` | number | share of scored records in the window whose served feature values disagree with the source record or the event history |\n| `programme_effect_pp` | number | effect of the reminder programme on the no-show rate, in percentage points, in the score band the programme acts on, stratified by clinic size band |\n| `attribution_auc` | object | how the gap between `validation_auc` and `monitored_auc` divides between causes, in AUC points |\n| `decision` | string | the action MRM-04 §4.3-§4.4 requires |\n\n### `auc_by_scoring`\n\nExactly these four keys:\n\n    as_served · record_features_asof_window · feature_store_current · candidate_v4\n\n`as_served` is the scores in `model_scores` for the model under review. `record_features_asof_window` is the\nmodel rescored from its published coefficients over the source record and the event history, on the feature\nwindow the registry records for it. `feature_store_current` is the model rescored over the feature store as it\nnow stands. `candidate_v4` is the candidate's scores.\n\n### `attribution_auc`\n\nExactly these five keys, summing to `validation_auc - monitored_auc` within 0.01:\n\n    population_drift · feature_feed_defect · feature_vintage · policy_feedback · other\n\nAny key may be zero or negative. Do not add or rename keys.\n\n### `decision`\n\nOne of `retain_model`, `retrain_on_recent_data`, `replace_with_v4`, `remediate_feature_pipeline`.\n\n## out/evaluation_population.csv\n\nHeader `clinic_id,n_appointments,no_show_rate,auc_as_served`, one row per clinic in the population you\nevaluated on.\n\n## Rules\n\n* Do not modify `data/appointments.sqlite`.\n* The command must be re-runnable and produce the same outputs for the same database.\n* AUCs to at least three decimals; rates and effects in percentage points.","is_error":false}]},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"caf8cf26-bb72-4bfb-990c-7900f246f6be","uuid":"d72553a4-2cc3-453c-b205-29aa3affd406","timestamp":"2026-10-01T06:38:01.141Z","tool_use_result":{"stdout":"./README.md\n./data/appointments.sqlite\n./notes/ops_notes.md\n./mlops/__init__.py\n./mlops/monitor.py\n./mlops/data.py\n./mlops/metrics.py\n./mlops/scoring.py\n./mlops/__main__.py\n./mlops/cli.py\n./docs/model_risk_standard.md\n./docs/reminder_programme_sop.md\n./docs/table_dictionary.md\n./reports/vendor_monitoring_report.md\n./docs/outputs/readout_contract.md\n\n# MRM-04 — Model risk management standard (extract)\n\nHalcyon Health Partners. {"type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01JHfKkKu1o1PNRbJt7CrY7B","type":"tool_result","content":"# Model monitoring — noshow-v3.1\n\n    python -m mlops monitor --db data/appointments.sqlite --out out\n\nWrites the monitoring readout. `docs/outputs/readout_contract.md` is the output specification in force.\n`docs/` holds MRM-04 (the model risk standard), SOP-118 (the reminder programme) and the table dictionary;\n`reports/` holds the vendor's monitoring review; `notes/` holds platform and operations notes.\n\n`data/appointments.sqlite` is read-only. Do not modify it.\n# Clinical Operations / data platform — running notes (extracts)\n\n**w27** Reminder programme live. Calling threshold fixed from the pre-programme score distribution. Ramp by\nclinic group over six weeks as per SOP-118. Excluded clinics set at kick-off and logged in the policy config.\n\n**w29** Early read from Clinical Ops: DNA down in the clinics that have joined. They are pleased.\n\n**w33** Platform change: the no-show count in the feature store was widened from the rolling twelve months to a\nlonger window, to make the feature more stable for low-volume clinics. Change request CR-2291. The model was\nnot re-fitted; nobody flagged that the registry records the window the model was defined on.\n\n**w34** Vendor asked for a feature-store extract for retraining. Sent.\n\n**w38** New partnership referral source now a material share of first appointments. Lead times on those are\nlonger. Clinical Ops expect DNA to be higher for them.\n\n**w41** Vendor monitoring dashboard showing AUC falling. Raised with the model owner.\n\n**w48** Model owner asked whether the monitoring population is the right one under MRM-04 §4.1. No answer yet.\n\n**w52** Vendor proposing we adopt v4.0. Clinical Ops want a decision before the winter capacity plan.\n# noshow-v3.1 — monitoring review and retrain proposal\nPrepared by Calder Analytics (model vendor) for Halcyon Health Partners. 2026-07-02.\n\n## Summary\n\n`noshow-v3.1` has lost discrimination since deployment. Against a validation figure of **0.774 AUC**, the\nmonitoring series for the most recent twelve weeks stands at **0.702 AUC**, a fall of 7.2 points.\n\nWe attribute the fall to data drift and recommend adopting the retrained `noshow-v4.0`.\n\n## Evidence\n\n**Feature drift.** Population Stability Index against the training period exceeds the usual 0.2 action\nthreshold on four features, and the referral mix has changed materially since month 4 with the arrival of the\npartnership source. Lead times on partnership referrals run roughly eight days longer.\n\n**Monotone decline.** The weekly AUC series in `monitoring_metrics` declines through the period. The decline is\nnot confined to any one clinic group.\n\n**Temporal validation.** Training on the earlier part of the period and testing on the later part reproduces\nthe decline, which rules out an evaluation artefact.\n\n**Retrain restores performance.** `noshow-v4.0`, fitted on data from the programme period onward, achieves\n0.79 AUC when validated on a recent holdout drawn from the clinics the programme covers. Scores for every\nappointment in the extract are supplied in `model_scores` so that Halcyon can reproduce this.\n\n## Recommendation\n\nAdopt `noshow-v4.0`. We further recommend moving to a quarterly retrain cadence, since the drift we observe\nappears to be ongoing rather than a one-off shift.\n\n## Notes\n\nThe monitoring series is computed from the feature store as it currently stands, which we rebuilt in week 33\nwhen the no-show count window was widened. We have not recomputed the series on the earlier feature definition.\n\"\"\"Halcyon Health Partners model monitoring.\"\"\"\n__all__ = [\"cli\", \"data\", \"metrics\", \"monitor\"]\nimport sys\n\nfrom mlops.cli import main\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    sys.exit(main(sys.argv[1:]))\nimport argparse\n\nfrom mlops.monitor import write_readout\n\n\ndef main(argv=None):\n    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog=\"mlops\", description=\"model monitoring readout\")\n    sub = ap.add_subparsers(dest=\"cmd\", required=True)\n    m = sub.add_parser(\"monitor\", help=\"produce the monitoring readout\")\n    m.add_argument(\"--db\", default=\"data/appointments.sqlite\")\n    m.add_argument(\"--out\", default=\"out\")\n    a = ap.parse_args(argv)\n    if a.cmd == \"monitor\":\n        write_readout(a.db, a.out)\n    return 0\n\"\"\"Database access for the monitoring readout.\"\"\"\nimport json\nimport sqlite3\n\nWINDOW_WEEKS = 12\nMODEL = \"noshow-v3.1\"\nCANDIDATE = \"noshow-v4.0\"\n\n\ndef connect(db_path):\n    con = sqlite3.connect(f\"file:{db_path}?mode=ro\", uri=True)\n    con.row_factory = sqlite3.Row\n    return con\n\n\ndef last_week(con):\n    return con.execute(\"SELECT MAX(week) AS w FROM appointments\").fetchone()[\"w\"]\n\n\ndef window(con):\n    lw = last_week(con)\n    return (lw - WINDOW_WEEKS + 1, lw)\n\n\ndef appointments(con, lo, hi):\n    return con.execute(\n        \"SELECT a.*, f.prior_no_shows_12m AS served_prior, f.deprivation_decile AS served_decile, \"\n        \"       f.age_band AS served_age, f.appointment_type AS served_type, \"\n        \"       s.score AS score_v31, v.score AS score_v4 \"\n        \"FROM appointments a \"\n        \"JOIN feature_snapshots f ON f.appt_id = a.appt_id \"\n        \"LEFT JOIN model_scores s ON s.appt_id = a.appt_id AND s.model_version = ? \"\n        \"LEFT JOIN model_scores v ON v.appt_id = a.appt_id AND v.model_version = ? \"\n        \"WHERE a.week BETWEEN ? AND ?\", (MODEL, CANDIDATE, lo, hi)).fetchall()\n\n\ndef registry(con, version=MODEL):\n    return con.execute(\"SELECT * FROM model_registry WHERE model_version = ?\", (version,)).fetchone()\n\n\ndef coefficients(con, version=MODEL):\n    row = registry(con, version)\n    return json.loads(row[\"coefficients_json\"]) if row and row[\"coefficients_json\"] else None\n\n\ndef policy(con):\n    return {r[\"key\"]: r[\"value\"] for r in con.execute(\"SELECT key, value FROM policy_config\")}\n\n\ndef monitored_auc(con, lo, hi):\n    rows = con.execute(\n        \"SELECT value FROM monitoring_metrics WHERE metric='auc' AND week BETWEEN ? AND ?\", (lo, hi)).fetchall()\n    return sum(r[\"value\"] for r in rows) / len(rows) if rows else None\n\"\"\"Discrimination and rate helpers.\"\"\"\n\n\ndef auc(scores, labels):\n    pairs = sorted(zip(scores, labels))\n    n = len(pairs)\n    ranks = [0.0] * n\n    i = 0\n    while i < n:\n        j = i\n        while j + 1 < n and pairs[j + 1][0] == pairs[i][0]:\n            j += 1\n        r = (i + j) / 2.0 + 1.0\n        for k in range(i, j + 1):\n            ranks[k] = r\n        i = j + 1\n    pos = sum(1 for _, y in pairs if y == 1)\n    neg = n - pos\n    if pos == 0 or neg == 0:\n        return None\n    s = sum(r for r, (_, y) in zip(ranks, pairs) if y == 1)\n    return (s - pos * (pos + 1) / 2.0) / (pos * neg)\n\n\ndef no_show_rate_pct(rows):\n    return 100.0 * sum(r[\"no_show\"] for r in rows) / len(rows) if rows else None\n\"\"\"Monitoring readout for noshow-v3.1.\n\nThe AUC is taken over the clinics the reminder programme covers, which is the population the dashboard has\nalways reported on, using the feature store as it currently stands.\n\"\"\"\nimport json\nimport os\n\nfrom mlops import data, metrics, scoring\n\n\ndef write_readout(db_path, out_dir):\n    os.makedirs(out_dir, exist_ok=True)\n    con = data.connect(db_path)\n    try:\n        lo, hi = data.window(con)\n        rows = data.appointments(con, lo, hi)\n        reg = data.registry(con)\n        coef = data.coefficients(con)\n        cur = {r[\"appt_id\"]: scoring.score_feature_store_current(coef, r) for r in rows}\n        monitored = metrics.auc([cur[r[\"appt_id\"]] for r in rows], [r[\"no_show\"] for r in rows])\n        validation = reg[\"validation_auc\"]\n        readout = {\n            \"model_version\": data.MODEL,\n            \"window_weeks\": [lo, hi],\n            \"monitored_auc\": round(monitored, 4),\n            \"validation_auc\": validation,\n            \"auc_by_scoring\": {\n                \"as_served\": round(monitored, 4),\n                \"candidate_v4\": round(metrics.auc([r[\"score_v4\"] for r in rows],\n                                                  [r[\"no_show\"] for r in rows]), 4),\n            },\n            \"attribution_auc\": {\n                \"population_drift\": round(validation - monitored, 4),\n                \"feature_feed_defect\": 0.0,\n                \"feature_vintage\": 0.0,\n                \"policy_feedback\": 0.0,\n                \"other\": 0.0,\n            },\n            \"decision\": \"replace_with_v4\",\n        }\n        with open(os.path.join(out_dir, \"readout.json\"), \"w\") as fh:\n            json.dump(readout, fh, indent=2, sort_keys=True)\n            fh.write(\"\\n\")\n    finally:\n        con.close()\n\"\"\"Rescoring noshow-v3.1 from the coefficients published in the model registry.\n\nThe registry records the feature definitions the model was fitted on: `prior_no_shows_12m` is the count of\ndid-not-attend events in a rolling window before booking, capped, and the continuous features are centred.\n\"\"\"\nPRIOR_CAP = 3\nCENTRES = {\"lead_time_days\": 21.0, \"deprivation_decile\": 5.5, \"distance_km\": 8.0}\n\n\ndef score(coef, prior_no_shows, lead_time_days, deprivation_decile, distance_km, age_band, appointment_type):\n    z = (coef[\"intercept\"]\n         + coef[\"prior_no_shows_12m\"] * min(prior_no_shows, PRIOR_CAP)\n         + coef[\"lead_time_days_c\"] * (lead_time_days - Do not modify it.\n# Clinical Operations / data platform — running notes (extracts)\n\n**w27** Reminder programme live. Calling threshold fixed from the pre-programme score distribution. Ramp by\nclinic group over six weeks as per SOP-118. Excluded clinics set at kick-off and logged in the policy config.\n\n**w29** Early read from Clinical Ops: DNA down in the clinics that have joined. cat > /tmp/load.py <<'EOF'\nimport sqlite3,pandas as pd,numpy as np,json\nc=sqlite3.connect('file:data/appointments.sqlite?mode=ro',uri=True)\nA=pd.read_sql(\"select * from appointments\",c)\nF=pd.read_sql(\"select * from feature_snapshots\",c)\nS=pd.read_sql(\"select * from model_scores\",c).pivot(index='appt_id',columns='model_version',values='score')\nS.columns=['v31','v4']\nE=pd.read_sql(\"select * from attendance_events\",c)\nR=pd.read_sql(\"select * from reminder_calls\",c)\nCL=pd.read_sql(\"select * from clinics\",c)\nD=A.merge(F,on='appt_id',suffixes=('','_f')).merge(S,left_on='appt_id',right_index=True).merge(R,on='appt_id',how='left').merge(CL[['clinic_id','size_band','ramp_group']],on='clinic_id')\nEXC='CL-001,CL-005,CL-012,CL-028,CL-038'.split(',')\nD['excl']=D.clinic_id.isin(EXC)\ndef auc(s,y):\n    s=np.asarray(s);y=np.asarray(y);r=pd.Series(s).rank().values;p=y.sum();n=len(y)-p\n    return (r[y==1].sum()-p*(p+1)/2)/(p*n)\nEOF\npython - <<'EOF'\nexec(open('/tmp/load.py').read())\nprint(len(D))\nfor col in ['lead_time_days','deprivation_decile','distance_km','age_band','appointment_type']:\n    print(col,(D[col]!=D[col+'_f']).sum())\nprint((D.booked_on!=D.scored_on).sum())\nprint(D.groupby('week').outcome.apply(lambda x:x.notna().sum()).to_string())\nEOF"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"container":null,"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":154,"cache_read_input_tokens":28992,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":154,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0},"output_tokens":3,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"global"},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"caf8cf26-bb72-4bfb-990c-7900f246f6be","uuid":"62b77485-c409-47c4-9d95-5139590400c0","timestamp":"2026-10-01T06:38:27.448Z","request_id":"req_011Cfb4Frgi6oSNBaS8Gm15r"}

{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-opus-5-5","id":"msg_011Cfb4Ss84AtQnVpHUZhb5V","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_012vnbXksmDGm8nmsgDMd59m","name":"Bash","input":{"command":"cd /workspace; cp -r mlops /tmp/mlops_orig; cat > mlops/data.py <<'EOF'\n\"\"\"Database access for the monitoring readout.\"\"\"\nimport json\nimport sqlite3\n\nWINDOW_WEEKS = 12\nMODEL = \"noshow-v3.1\"\nCANDIDATE = \"noshow-v4.0\"\n\n\ndef connect(db_path):\n    con = sqlite3.connect(f\"file:{db_path}?mode=ro\", uri=True)\n    con.row_factory = sqlite3.Row\n    return con\n\n\ndef last_week(con):\n    return con.execute(\"SELECT MAX(week) AS w FROM appointments\").fetchone()[\"w\"]\n\n\ndef window(con):\n    lw = last_week(con)\n    return (lw - WINDOW_WEEKS + 1, lw)\n\n\ndef appointments(con):\n    \"\"\"Every appointment with what the scorer was served, the scores, the clinic and any reminder call.\n\n    `prior_no_show_count` on `appointments` is the current feature table (see policy_config); the value the\n    scorer was given at booking is `feature_snapshots.prior_no_shows_12m`.\"\"\"\n    return con.execute(\n        \"SELECT a.*, f.prior_no_shows_12m AS served_prior, f.lead_time_days AS served_lead, \"\n        \"       f.deprivation_decile AS served_decile, f.distance_km AS served_distance, \"\n        \"       f.age_band AS served_age, f.appointment_type AS served_type, \"\n        \"       s.score AS score_v31, v.score AS score_v4, c.size_band, rc.outcome AS call_outcome \"\n        \"FROM appointments a \"\n        \"JOIN feature_snapshots f ON f.appt_id = a.appt_id \"\n        \"JOIN clinics c ON c.clinic_id = a.clinic_id \"\n        \"LEFT JOIN model_scores s ON s.appt_id = a.appt_id AND s.model_version = ? \"\n        \"LEFT JOIN model_scores v ON v.appt_id = a.appt_id AND v.model_version = ? \"\n        \"LEFT JOIN reminder_calls rc ON rc.appt_id = a.appt_id \"\n        \"ORDER BY a.appt_id\", (MODEL, CANDIDATE)).fetchall()\n\n\ndef did_not_attend_dates(con):\n    \"\"\"Append-only DNA history per patient (including events that predate the extract), sorted.\"\"\"\n    out = {}\n    for r in con.execute(\"SELECT patient_id, event_on FROM attendance_events \"\n                         \"WHERE event_type = 'DID_NOT_ATTEND' ORDER BY patient_id, event_on\"):\n        out.setdefault(r[\"patient_id\"], []).append(r[\"event_on\"])\n    return out\n\n\ndef clinics_with_calls(con):\n    return {r[\"clinic_id\"] for r in con.execute(\n        \"SELECT DISTINCT a.clinic_id FROM reminder_calls rc JOIN appointments a ON a.appt_id = rc.appt_id\")}\n\n\ndef registry(con, version=MODEL):\n    return con.execute(\"SELECT * FROM model_registry WHERE model_version = ?\", (version,)).fetchone()\n\n\ndef coefficients(con, version=MODEL):\n    row = registry(con, version)\n    return json.loads(row[\"coefficients_json\"]) if row and row[\"coefficients_json\"] else None\n\n\ndef policy(con):\n    return {r[\"key\"]: r[\"value\"] for r in con.execute(\"SELECT key, value FROM policy_config\")}\n\n\ndef monitored_auc(con, lo, hi):\n    \"\"\"Mean of the weekly AUC the monitoring series reports over the window.\"\"\"\n    rows = con.execute(\n        \"SELECT value FROM monitoring_metrics WHERE metric='auc' AND week BETWEEN ? AND ? ORDER BY week\",\n        (lo, hi)).fetchall()\n    return sum(r[\"value\"] for r in rows) / len(rows) if rows else None\nEOF\ncat > mlops/scoring.py <<'EOF'\n\"\"\"Rescoring noshow-v3.1 from the coefficients published in the model registry.\n\nThe registry records the feature definitions the model was fitted on: `prior_no_shows_12m` is the count of\ndid-not-attend events in a rolling window before booking (`feature_window_days`, 365), capped, and the\ncontinuous features are centred.\n\"\"\"\nimport bisect\nimport math\nfrom datetime import date, timedelta\n\nPRIOR_CAP = 3\nCENTRES = {\"lead_time_days\": 21.0, \"deprivation_decile\": 5.5, \"distance_km\": 8.0}\n\n\ndef score(coef, prior_no_shows, lead_time_days, deprivation_decile, distance_km, age_band, appointment_type):\n    z = (coef[\"intercept\"]\n         + coef[\"prior_no_shows_12m\"] * min(prior_no_shows, PRIOR_CAP)\n         + coef[\"lead_time_days_c\"] * (lead_time_days - CENTRES[\"lead_time_days\"])\n         + coef[\"deprivation_decile_c\"] * (deprivation_decile - CENTRES[\"deprivation_decile\"])\n         + coef[\"distance_km_c\"] * (distance_km - CENTRES[\"distance_km\"])\n         + coef[f\"age_{age_band}\"]\n         + coef[f\"type_{appointment_type}\"])\n    if z < -35:\n        return 0.0\n    if z > 35:\n        return 1.0\n    return 1.0 / (1.0 + math.exp(-z))\n\n\ndef prior_no_shows_asof(dna_dates, booked_on, window_days):\n    \"\"\"DNA events in [booked_on - window_days, booked_on) from the sorted event history.\"\"\"\n    lo = (date.fromisoformat(booked_on) - timedelta(days=window_days)).isoformat()\n    return bisect.bisect_left(dna_dates, booked_on) - bisect.bisect_left(dna_dates, lo)\n\n\ndef score_served_features(coef, row):\n    \"\"\"The published model over exactly the values the scorer was given at booking.\"\"\"\n    return score(coef, row[\"served_prior\"], row[\"served_lead\"], row[\"served_decile\"],\n                 row[\"served_distance\"], row[\"served_age\"], row[\"served_type\"])\n\n\ndef score_record_asof_window(coef, row, prior_asof):\n    \"\"\"The published model over the source record, with the no-show count rebuilt from the event history on\n    the window the registry records for the model.\"\"\"\n    return score(coef, prior_asof, row[\"lead_time_days\"], row[\"deprivation_decile\"],\n                 row[\"distance_km\"], row[\"age_band\"], row[\"appointment_type\"])\n\n\ndef score_feature_store_current(coef, row):\n    \"\"\"The feature store as it now stands: the no-show count over the window currently configured (CR-2291\n    widened it after deployment; the model was not re-fitted).\"\"\"\n    return score(coef, row[\"prior_no_show_count\"], row[\"lead_time_days\"], row[\"deprivation_decile\"],\n                 row[\"distance_km\"], row[\"age_band\"], row[\"appointment_type\"])\nEOF"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"container":null,"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":1137,"cache_read_input_tokens":45540,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":1137,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0},"output_tokens":8,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"global"},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"caf8cf26-bb72-4bfb-990c-7900f246f6be","uuid":"a3c2f077-ab7c-4431-af3e-43eeee9eec8f","timestamp":"2026-10-01T06:41:18.461Z","request_id":"req_011Cfb4Sr2aHecE1wzNbA7WB"}

{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-opus-5-5","id":"msg_011Cfb4V5z1xGXaTZwMHCfp6","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01MNa9kRcZyaeedrJrvkKScc","name":"Bash","input":{"command":"cd /workspace; cat > mlops/monitor.py <<'EOF'\n\"\"\"Monitoring readout for noshow-v3.1 under MRM-04.\n\nPopulation (§4.1). noshow-v3.1's score selects bookings for reminder calls (SOP-118), and calls change the\noutcome the model predicts, so the clinics in the programme are not a valid monitoring population. The clinics\nlisted in `programme.excluded_clinics` were drawn stratified by size band at programme start and receive no\nscore-driven calling; they are the evaluation population. Any listed clinic that has calls is dropped.\n\nScoring basis (§4.2). The retention test uses the scores noshow-v3.1 produced at booking (`model_scores`). The\nmodel is also rescored from its published coefficients over the source record and the event history on the\nregistry's feature window, and over the feature store as it now stands; the vendor's monitoring series is the\nlatter, over all clinics.\n\nAttribution. The gap between the validation figure and the monitored figure is walked in steps, each step\nchanging one thing, so the five parts sum to the gap exactly:\n\n    validation (registry)\n      -> as served, evaluation population, window             population_drift\n      -> published coefficients over served features            other (scorer vs published coefficients)\n      -> published coefficients over source + event history     feature_feed_defect\n      -> published coefficients over current feature store      feature_vintage\n      -> same basis, all clinics, pooled                        policy_feedback\n      -> monitoring series (mean of weekly AUCs)                other (pooled vs weekly mean)\n\"\"\"\nimport csv\nimport json\nimport os\n\nfrom mlops import data, metrics, scoring\n\nAUC_DP = 4\nPCT_DP = 3\n\n\ndef _quantile(values, q):\n    v = sorted(values)\n    pos = (len(v) - 1) * q\n    lo = int(pos)\n    hi = min(lo + 1, len(v) - 1)\n    return v[lo] + (v[hi] - v[lo]) * (pos - lo)\n\n\ndef _auc(rows, key):\n    return metrics.auc([r[key] for r in rows], [r[\"no_show\"] for r in rows])\n\n\ndef _rescore(con, rows, coef, window_days):\n    dna = data.did_not_attend_dates(con)\n    out = []\n    for r in rows:\n        d = dict(r)\n        d[\"prior_asof\"] = scoring.prior_no_shows_asof(dna.get(r[\"patient_id\"], []), r[\"booked_on\"], window_days)\n        d[\"s_served\"] = scoring.score_served_features(coef, r)\n        d[\"s_record\"] = scoring.score_record_asof_window(coef, r, d[\"prior_asof\"])\n        d[\"s_current\"] = scoring.score_feature_store_current(coef, r)\n        out.append(d)\n    return out\n\n\ndef _feed_defect(r):\n    return (r[\"served_prior\"] != r[\"prior_asof\"]\n            or r[\"served_lead\"] != r[\"lead_time_days\"]\n            or r[\"served_decile\"] != r[\"deprivation_decile\"]\n            or r[\"served_distance\"] != r[\"distance_km\"]\n            or r[\"served_age\"] != r[\"age_band\"]\n            or r[\"served_type\"] != r[\"appointment_type\"])\n\n\ndef _programme_effect_pp(rows, threshold, programme_clinics, control_clinics):\n    \"\"\"No-show rate in programme clinics minus control clinics, within the called score band, by size band,\n    weighted by the programme clinics' in-band volume.\"\"\"\n    strata = {}\n    for r in rows:\n        if r[\"score_v31\"] < threshold:\n            continue\n        arm = \"p\" if r[\"clinic_id\"] in programme_clinics else \"c\" if r[\"clinic_id\"] in control_clinics else None\n        if arm:\n            strata.setdefault(r[\"size_band\"], {\"p\": [], \"c\": []})[arm].append(r[\"no_show\"])\n    num = den = 0.0\n    for s in strata.values():\n        if s[\"p\"] and s[\"c\"]:\n            diff = 100.0 * (sum(s[\"p\"]) / len(s[\"p\"]) - sum(s[\"c\"]) / len(s[\"c\"]))\n            num += diff * len(s[\"p\"])\n            den += len(s[\"p\"])\n    return num / den if den else None\n\n\ndef _decision(as_served, floor, defect_pct, record_auc, candidate, incumbent):\n    if as_served >= floor:\n        return \"retain_model\"\n    if defect_pct > 5.0 and record_auc is not None and record_auc >= floor:\n        return \"remediate_feature_pipeline\"\n    if candidate is not None and candidate - incumbent > 0.02:\n        return \"replace_with_v4\"\n    return \"retrain_on_recent_data\"\n\n\ndef write_readout(db_path, out_dir):\n    os.makedirs(out_dir, exist_ok=True)\n    con = data.connect(db_path)\n    try:\n        lo, hi = data.window(con)\n        reg = data.registry(con)\n        coef = data.coefficients(con)\n        pol = data.policy(con)\n        all_rows = data.appointments(con)\n        rows = _rescore(con, [r for r in all_rows if lo <= r[\"week\"] <= hi], coef, reg[\"feature_window_days\"])\n\n        # §4.1 population: clinics outside the programme with no calls\n        listed = [c.strip() for c in pol[\"programme.excluded_clinics\"].split(\",\") if c.strip()]\n        called = data.clinics_with_calls(con)\n        eval_clinics = sorted(c for c in listed if c not in called)\n        ev = [r for r in rows if r[\"clinic_id\"] in eval_clinics]\n\n        validation = reg[\"validation_auc\"]\n        monitored = data.monitored_auc(con, lo, hi)\n        floor = max(validation - 0.04, 0.70)\n\n        auc_ev = {k: _auc(ev, k) for k in (\"score_v31\", \"s_served\", \"s_record\", \"s_current\", \"score_v4\")}\n        auc_all_current = _auc(rows, \"s_current\")\n        defect_pct = 100.0 * sum(1 for r in rows if _feed_defect(r)) / len(rows)\n\n        # SOP-118: threshold fixed from the pre-programme distribution of the programme's score model\n        start = int(pol[\"programme.start_week\"])\n        pre = [r[\"score_v31\"] for r in all_rows if r[\"week\"] < start]\n        threshold = _quantile(pre, 1.0 - float(pol[\"programme.score_percentile\"]))\n        programme_clinics = {r[\"clinic_id\"] for r in all_rows} - set(listed)\n        effect = _programme_effect_pp(rows, threshold, programme_clinics, set(eval_clinics))\n\n        attribution = {\n            \"population_drift\": validation - auc_ev[\"score_v31\"],\n            \"feature_feed_defect\": auc_ev[\"s_served\"] - auc_ev[\"s_record\"],\n            \"feature_vintage\": auc_ev[\"s_record\"] - auc_ev[\"s_current\"],\n            \"policy_feedback\": auc_ev[\"s_current\"] - auc_all_current,\n            \"other\": (auc_ev[\"score_v31\"] - auc_ev[\"s_served\"]) + (auc_all_current - monitored),\n        }\n\n        decision = _decision(auc_ev[\"score_v31\"], floor, defect_pct, auc_ev[\"s_record\"],\n                             auc_ev[\"score_v4\"], {"type":"system","subtype":"task_started","task_id":"bzgbuajrp","tool_use_id":"toolu_01MNa9kRcZyaeedrJrvkKScc","description":"cd /workspace; cat > mlops/monitor.py <<'EOF'\n\"\"\"Monitoring readout for noshow-v3.1 under MRM-04.\n\nPopulation (§4.1). noshow-v3.1's score selects bookings for reminder calls (SOP-118), and calls change the\noutcome the model predicts, so the clinics in the programme are not a valid monitoring population. The clinics\nlisted in `programme.excluded_clinics` were drawn stratified by size band at programme start and receive no\nscore-driven calling; they are the evaluation population. Any listed clinic that has calls is dropped.\n\nScoring basis (§4.2). The retention test uses the scores noshow-v3.1 produced at booking (`model_scores`). The\nmodel is also rescored from its published coefficients over the source record and the event history on the\nregistry's feature window, and over the feature store as it now stands; the vendor's monitoring series is the\nlatter, over all clinics.\n\nAttribution. The gap between the validation figure and the monitored figure is walked in steps, each step\nchanging one thing, so the five parts sum to the gap exactly:\n\n    validation (registry)\n      -> as served, evaluation population, window             population_drift\n      -> published coefficients over served features            other (scorer vs published coefficients)\n      -> published coefficients over source + event history     feature_feed_defect\n      -> published coefficients over current feature store      feature_vintage\n      -> same basis, all clinics, pooled                        policy_feedback\n      -> monitoring series (mean of weekly AUCs)                other (pooled vs weekly mean)\n\"\"\"\nimport csv\nimport json\nimport os\n\nfrom mlops import data, metrics, scoring\n\nAUC_DP = 4\nPCT_DP = 3\n\n\ndef _quantile(values, q):\n    v = sorted(values)\n    pos = (len(v) - 1) * q\n    lo = int(pos)\n    hi = min(lo + 1, len(v) - 1)\n    return v[lo] + (v[hi] - v[lo]) * (pos - lo)\n\n\ndef _auc(rows, key):\n    return metrics.auc([r[key] for r in rows], [r[\"no_show\"] for r in rows])\n\n\ndef _rescore(con, rows, coef, window_days):\n    dna = data.did_not_attend_dates(con)\n    out = []\n    for r in rows:\n        d = dict(r)\n        d[\"prior_asof\"] = scoring.prior_no_shows_asof(dna.get(r[\"patient_id\"], []), r[\"booked_on\"], window_days)\n        d[\"s_served\"] = scoring.score_served_features(coef, r)\n        d[\"s_record\"] = scoring.score_record_asof_window(coef, r, d[\"prior_asof\"])\n        d[\"s_current\"] = scoring.score_feature_store_current(coef, r)\n        out.append(d)\n    return out\n\n\ndef _feed_defect(r):\n    return (r[\"served_prior\"] != r[\"prior_asof\"]\n            or r[\"served_lead\"] != r[\"lead_time_days\"]\n            or r[\"served_decile\"] != r[\"deprivation_decile\"]\n            or r[\"served_distance\"] != r[\"distance_km\"]\n            or r[\"served_age\"] != r[\"age_band\"]\n            or r[\"served_type\"] != r[\"appointment_type\"])\n\n\ndef _programme_effect_pp(rows, threshold, programme_clinics, control_clinics):\n    \"\"\"No-show rate in programme clinics minus control clinics, within the called score band, by size band,\n    weighted by the programme clinics' in-band volume.\"\"\"\n    strata = {}\n    for r in rows:\n        if r[\"score_v31\"] < threshold:\n            continue\n        arm = \"p\" if r[\"clinic_id\"] in programme_clinics else \"c\" if r[\"clinic_id\"] in control_clinics else None\n        if arm:\n            strata.setdefault(r[\"size_band\"], {\"p\": [], \"c\": []})[arm].append(r[\"no_show\"])\n    num = den = 0.0\n    for s in strata.values():\n        if s[\"p\"] and s[\"c\"]:\n            diff = 100.0 * (sum(s[\"p\"]) / len(s[\"p\"]) - sum(s[\"c\"]) / len(s[\"c\"]))\n            num += diff * len(s[\"p\"])\n            den += len(s[\"p\"])\n    return num / den if den else None\n\n\ndef _decision(as_served, floor, defect_pct, record_auc, candidate, incumbent):\n    if as_served >= floor:\n        return \"retain_model\"\n    if defect_pct > 5.0 and record_auc is not None and record_auc >= floor:\n        return \"remediate_feature_pipeline\"\n    if candidate is not None and candidate - incumbent > 0.02:\n        return \"replace_with_v4\"\n    return \"retrain_on_recent_data\"\n\n\ndef write_readout(db_path, out_dir):\n    os.makedirs(out_dir, exist_ok=True)\n    con = data.connect(db_path)\n    try:\n        lo, hi = data.window(con)\n        reg = data.registry(con)\n        coef = data.coefficients(con)\n        pol = data.policy(con)\n        all_rows = data.appointments(con)\n        rows = _rescore(con, [r for r in all_rows if lo <= r[\"week\"] <= hi], coef, reg[\"feature_window_days\"])\n\n        # §4.1 population: clinics outside the programme with no calls\n        listed = [c.strip() for c in pol[\"programme.excluded_clinics\"].split(\",\") if c.strip()]\n        called = data.clinics_with_calls(con)\n        eval_clinics = sorted(c for c in listed if c not in called)\n        ev = [r for r in rows if r[\"clinic_id\"] in eval_clinics]\n\n        validation = reg[\"validation_auc\"]\n        monitored = data.monitored_auc(con, lo, hi)\n        floor = max(validation - 0.04, 0.70)\n\n        auc_ev = {k: _auc(ev, k) for k in (\"score_v31\", \"s_served\", \"s_record\", \"s_current\", \"score_v4\")}\n        auc_all_current = _auc(rows, \"s_current\")\n        defect_pct = 100.0 * sum(1 for r in rows if _feed_defect(r)) / len(rows)\n\n        # SOP-118: threshold fixed from the pre-programme distribution of the programme's score model\n        start = int(pol[\"programme.start_week\"])\n        pre = [r[\"score_v31\"] for r in all_rows if r[\"week\"] < start]\n        threshold = _quantile(pre, 1.0 - float(pol[\"programme.score_percentile\"]))\n        programme_clinics = {r[\"clinic_id\"] for r in all_rows} - set(listed)\n        effect = _programme_effect_pp(rows, threshold, programme_clinics, set(eval_clinics))\n\n        attribution = {\n            \"population_drift\": validation - auc_ev[\"score_v31\"],\n            \"feature_feed_defect\": auc_ev[\"s_served\"] - auc_ev[\"s_record\"],\n            \"feature_vintage\": auc_ev[\"s_record\"] - auc_ev[\"s_current\"],\n            \"policy_feedback\": auc_ev[\"s_current\"] - auc_all_current,\n            \"other\": (auc_ev[\"score_v31\"] - auc_ev[\"s_served\"]) + (auc_all_current - monitored),\n        }\n\n        decision = _decision(auc_ev[\"score_v31\"], floor, defect_pct, auc_ev[\"s_record\"],\n                             auc_ev[\"score_v4\"], auc_ev[\"score_v31\"])\n\n        readout = {\n            \"model_version\": data.MODEL,\n            \"window_weeks\": [lo, hi],\n            \"monitored_auc\": round(monitored, AUC_DP),\n            \"validation_auc\": validation,\n            \"retention_floor_auc\": round(floor, AUC_DP),\n            \"evaluation_population\": {\"clinic_ids\": eval_clinics, \"n_appointments\": len(ev)},\n            \"auc_by_scoring\": {\n                \"as_served\": round(auc_ev[\"score_v31\"], AUC_DP),\n                \"record_features_asof_window\": round(auc_ev[\"s_record\"], AUC_DP),\n                \"feature_store_current\": round(auc_ev[\"s_current\"], AUC_DP),\n                \"candidate_v4\": round(auc_ev[\"score_v4\"], AUC_DP),\n            },\n            \"feed_defect_share_pct\": round(defect_pct, PCT_DP),\n            \"programme_effect_pp\": round(effect, 2),\n            \"attribution_auc\": {k: round(v, AUC_DP) for k, v in attribution.items()},\n            \"decision\": decision,\n        }\n        with open(os.path.join(out_dir, \"readout.json\"), \"w\") as fh:\n            json.dump(readout, fh, indent=2, sort_keys=True)\n            fh.write(\"\\n\")\n\n        with open(os.path.join(out_dir, \"evaluation_population.csv\"), \"w\", newline=\"\") as fh:\n            w = csv.writer(fh, lineterminator=\"\\n\")\n            w.writerow([\"clinic_id\", \"n_appointments\", \"no_show_rate\", \"auc_as_served\"])\n            for c in eval_clinics:\n                cr = [r for r in ev if r[\"clinic_id\"] == c]\n                w.writerow([c, len(cr), round(metrics.no_show_rate_pct(cr), 2), round(_auc(cr, \"score_v31\"), AUC_DP)])\n    finally:\n        con.close()\nEOF\nrm -rf out; time python -m mlops monitor --db data/appointments.sqlite --out out && cat out/readout.json out/evaluation_population.csv; md5sum out/*; python -m mlops monitor --db data/appointments.sqlite --out out; md5sum out/*","is_backgrounded":false,"task_type":"local_bash","uuid":"2de80071-6bb9-491e-b2a8-4586027da35a","session_id":"caf8cf26-bb72-4bfb-990c-7900f246f6be"}

{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-opus-5-5","id":"msg_011Cfb4Y2CuADU7BoU3FmWN4","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01D3yYhAd7z6qfPv4xdN45ot","name":"Bash","input":{"command":"cd /workspace; cat > reports/mrm04_monitoring_submission_noshow-v3.1.md <<'EOF'\n# MRM-04 monitoring submission — noshow-v3.1, production weeks 41–52\n\nModel owner submission. Reproduce with `python -m mlops monitor --db data/appointments.sqlite --out out`;\nevery figure below is in `out/readout.json` / `out/evaluation_population.csv`.\n\n## Records required by §5\n\n| item | value |\n|---|---|\n| Population (§4.1) | The five clinics outside the reminder programme (`programme.excluded_clinics`: CL-001, CL-005, CL-012, CL-028, CL-038), weeks 41–52, 4,136 appointments. These clinics were picked at programme start, stratified by size band, and have no reminder calls. Programme clinics are excluded because v3.1's score decides who gets a call, and the call changes the outcome. |\n| Scoring basis (§4.2) | Scores v3.1 produced at booking (`model_scores`) — **0.7904 AUC**. Rescored from the published coefficients over the source record and the 365-day event history: 0.7815. Rescored over the current feature store (730-day window, CR-2291): 0.7765. |\n| Validation figure | 0.7704 (model registry). This matches the as-served AUC on all clinics in pre-programme weeks 1–26. The vendor's 0.774 does not appear anywhere in the evidence. |\n| Retention floor (§4.3) | 0.7304 = max(0.7704 − 0.04, 0.70). Both conditions must hold, so the higher bound is the one that binds. |\n| **Action** | **`retain_model`**. 0.7904 ≥ 0.7304. |\n\n## Why the reported 0.71 is not a §4.3 figure\n\nThe vendor's series (mean 0.7105 over weeks 41–52; the report's 0.702 also does not appear in the evidence) is\ncomputed **on every clinic, including the 33 in the programme**, and **from the feature store as rebuilt after CR-2291**.\nThe model was never served those features. Neither choice is allowed for a retention decision under §4.1 or §4.2.\n\nHow the 0.0599 gap between validation and monitored AUC breaks down:\n\n| cause | AUC points | basis |\n|---|---|---|\n| policy_feedback | +0.0666 | same scoring, programme-excluded clinics vs all clinics |\n| feature_vintage | +0.0050 | 365-day record features vs current 730-day feature store |\n| other | +0.0082 | in-service scorer vs published-coefficient rescore (+0.0089); pooled vs weekly-mean (−0.0006) |\n| feature_feed_defect | 0.0000 | served features match the source and event history in 99.994% of window records (0.006% defective) |\n| population_drift | −0.0200 | discrimination on the uninfluenced population went *up*, not down |\n\nPolicy feedback mechanism: calls go to the top 45% of scores, using a threshold fixed from pre-programme scores\n(this reproduces every call). In that band, programme clinics show a **10.57 pp lower** no-show rate than excluded\nclinics (stratified by size band, weeks 41–52). Before the programme the gap was about 0.5 pp. The programme\nremoves the very no-shows the model ranks highest, so AUC measured on programme clinics falls. That is the\nintervention working, not the model degrading.\n\n## Candidate noshow-v4.0\n\nOn the §4.1 population v4.0 scores 0.7641, which is **0.026 below** the incumbent. It does not meet the §4.4(2)\ncondition (> 0.02 above). It was trained on programme-period data (2026-01-05 to 2026-07-06), so its labels\ninclude the effect of the calls, and its window AUC is partly in-sample. Its reported 0.79 holdout was taken\nfrom programme clinics, which is a population §4.1 rules out.\n\n## Follow-ups (not required for the retention decision)\n\n* The monitoring series should be moved to the excluded clinics and to the scores as served. CR-2291 changed\n  the feature store definition without a re-fit. The registry window (365 days) should be restored for anything\n  that rescored v3.1, or the change should go through model change control.\n* The excluded group has only five clinics (one LARGE), so the confidence interval on the window AUC is wide\n  (roughly ±0.025). Even so, 0.79 is well clear of the floor.\n* MRM-04 §4.3 says \"the lower of the two gives the retention floor\". Read alongside the \"and\" condition, that\n  wording is inconsistent. 0.7304 is used here. Under a 0.70 floor the decision is the same.\nEOF\ndiff -r /tmp/mlops_orig mlops | head -5 >/dev/null; ls out"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"container":null,"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":4229,"cache_read_input_tokens":50152,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":4229,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0},"output_tokens":8,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"global"},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"caf8cf26-bb72-4bfb-990c-7900f246f6be","uuid":"00f6044c-e727-4f43-b0b2-e25d082e1e20","timestamp":"2026-10-01T06:42:22.122Z","request_id":"req_011Cfb4Y1aw2rNrrTPzA3wy7"}

{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-opus-5-5","id":"msg_011Cfb4Ztd3o4otJaZhdVqkC","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"The decision is **`retain_model`**: on the population MRM-04 allows, noshow-v3.1's AUC on the scores it actually produced is **0.7904**, above the retention floor of **0.7304**. The fall to 0.71 comes mostly from the reminder programme acting on the model's own predictions, not from the model getting worse, and v4.0 does worse than v3.1 on the same population.\n\nThe repaired package runs with `python -m mlops monitor --db data/appointments.sqlite --out out`. Running it twice gives byte-identical outputs, and the database is untouched.\n\n**What was wrong in the package**\n- **Wrong scores.** The \"monitored\" figure, also labelled `as_served`, came from rescoring the model on the feature store as it stands now. Since change CR-2291 in week 33, that store counts no-shows over 730 days. The model was built on a 365-day count, and the values it was actually given at booking match that 365-day count from the event history in 99.995% of records.\n- **Wrong population.** It evaluated on all clinics, including the 33 where the model's score decides who gets a reminder call.\n- **Hardcoded output.** It put the whole gap down to population drift and hardcoded `replace_with_v4`. It also wrote no evaluation-population file.\n\nI rewrote `mlops/monitor.py` and extended `data.py` and `scoring.py` so they produce everything in `docs/outputs/readout_contract.md`.\n\n**Figures (weeks 41–52)**\n\n| | Value |\n|---|---|\n| Evaluation population | The 5 clinics excluded from the programme (CL-001, 005, 012, 028, 038); 4,136 appointments, no calls |\n| AUC on scores produced in service | **0.7904** |\n| AUC rescored on source records with the 365-day count | 0.7815 |\n| AUC rescored on the current feature store | 0.7765 |\n| AUC for candidate v4.0 | 0.7641 |\n| Validation figure (registry) | 0.7704 |\n| Monitoring series | 0.7105 |\n| Retention floor | 0.7304 |\n| Records where the served features disagree with source or history | 0.006% |\n| Programme effect on no-show rate | −10.57 pp |\n\n**Where the gap of 0.0599 between validation and monitored AUC comes from**\n\n| Cause | AUC points |\n|---|---|\n| Reminder programme acting on the model's output | +0.0666 |\n| Feature store rebuilt to the 730-day count | +0.0050 |\n| Other | +0.0082 |\n| Defects in the feature feed | 0.0000 |\n| Population drift | −0.0200 |\n\n\"Other\" is almost entirely the difference between the scores produced in service and a rescore from the published coefficients. Population drift is negative because, on the clinics the programme doesn't touch, discrimination went up.\n\n**Why the programme lowers the measured AUC**\n- **Calling threshold.** The programme calls the top 45% of scores, using a threshold fixed from scores before the programme started. Rebuilding that threshold reproduces every call.\n- **Effect on no-shows.** In that score band, no-show rates in programme clinics are about 10.6 points lower than in excluded clinics, within every clinic size. Before the programme the two groups were within 0.5 points.\n- **Result.** The calls prevent exactly the no-shows the model ranks highest, so AUC measured across programme clinics drops.\n\n**Applying MRM-04**\n- **Retention test.** 0.7904 is above the floor, so the model is retained and §4.4 never comes into play.\n- **The candidate.** v4.0 would not qualify for replacement anyway: it is 0.026 below v3.1 on the allowed population. It was trained on data from the programme period, and the vendor's 0.79 was measured on programme clinics, which the standard rules out.\n- **Vendor figures.** Neither the vendor's 0.774 validation figure nor their 0.702 monitoring figure appears anywhere in the data.\n\n**Judgement calls you should know about**\n- **The floor.** MRM-04 §4.3 says \"the lower of the two gives the retention floor\", but its rule requires both conditions. I used the stricter 0.7304. A 0.70 floor gives the same decision.\n- **Small sample.** Five clinics is a small group, so the 0.79 is uncertain by roughly ±0.025. It is still clear of the floor.\n- **Splitting the gap.** I split it by changing one thing at a time, in the order in the table's source. A different order would shift a few thousandths between the programme and feature-store lines.\n\nThe MRM-04 §5 submission is in `reports/mrm04_monitoring_submission_noshow-v3.1.md`. It also recommends moving the dashboard onto the excluded clinics and the scores produced in service, and putting CR-2291 through model change control.\n\nFiles are in `out/`:\n- readout.json\n- evaluation_population.csv"}],"container":null,"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":2166,"cache_read_input_tokens":54381,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":2166,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0},"output_tokens":3,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"global"},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"caf8cf26-bb72-4bfb-990c-7900f246f6be","uuid":"091363fc-eb40-45a8-a638-38b45ac7ddc1","timestamp":"2026-10-01T06:42:40.544Z","request_id":"req_011Cfb4Zt9248dSEB8To1ZbU"}
